name: FALmonsta's Multicam Bundle SHITTYFIX to 3.8.x
teaser:
an incredibly quick and dirty port of 3 of FALmonsta's multicam retextures to 3.8.x. Does not include Multicam Arid

Made with permission, will likely not be maintained
description_html:
Made with FALmonsta’s permission. Ask them about the original mods.

This is an incredibly shitty fix of FALmonsta’s Multicam, Multicam Tropic and Multicam Black gear and clothing bundles to 3.8.x. The only actual changes were to make it rely instead on AshleyShcaeffer’s BMWCore mod (a remake of the JustNU’s Core mod of which the original Multicam mods had as a dependency.

PREREQUISITES

  • AshleyShcaeffer’s BMWCore mod
  • The original Multicam mods (MC, MCT, MCB, you can include or leave out whatever)
  • Files included in these downloads.

INSTALLATION

  1. Download and install AshleyShcaeffer’s BMWCore mod
  2. Download and install your desired OG Multicam mods
  3. Download the files provided by this mod
  4. Replace FALmonsta’s original /src/mod.js and package.json with the mod.js and package.json included in this mod.
  5. Install as normal

ISSUES

  • some helmet and armored vest+rig reskins spawn in trader’s inventories with no built-in kevlar protection. idk whats up with that, but the Flea market variants are normal
    • helmets are totally fucked and operational ones (damaged but armored) aren’t even present on the flea
    • this might be an issue with BMWCore, but idk (i am new to this)
  • I disabled the code that adds the retextured gear (armored rigs, armored vests) to quests that restrict them. You may erroneously be able to complete quests that disallow wearing armored vests or rigs with the new retextured vests and rigs
    • for nerds, this is probably to do with the updated quest syntax between 3.6.x and 3.8.x. It’s a bit confusing, because when I looked at similar mods made for 3.8.x, they use the exact same syntax listed in the mod. Those ones don’t crash, but this still does. I don’t care enough to fix it or to update it.

This mod will most likely not be maintained.
